title: In Modem, there is a possible out of bounds read due to a missing bounds check. (CVE-2026-20594)
description: A vulnerability in the modem component allows an out of bounds read due to a missing bounds check. This flaw can be exploited remotely by an attacker controlling a rogue base station to cause a denial of service on a user equipment (UE) device without requiring user interaction or additional privileges. Patches identified as MOLY01349680 and MOLY01369097 address this issue.
